resources.string: YaNaviPeb reads the ongoing navigation notification from Yandex Maps or Yandex Navigator: the next maneuver, distance, street name, remaining distance and arrival time. This data is sent to the Pebble app and to your watch to show turn-by-turn directions. The app does not read any other notifications. The data is not stored and is not sent to any server; the app has no internet access.\n\nNext, Android will open the notification access settings, where you need to turn on YaNaviPeb.
For navigation to keep working in the background, disable battery optimization for YaNaviPeb and for the Pebble app.
The demo sends a recorded route to the watch. Do not run it while navigating in Yandex Maps or Yandex Navigator.
